```{python}
from render import make_regression_table, make_shock_regression_table
from specs import (
    jobloss,
    coal_shock,
    coal_shock_panel,
    fuel_shock,
    fuel_shock_panel,
    palm_shock,
    palm_shock_panel,
    temperature_spec,
    update_formula_search_replace,
)

temperature_spec = temperature_spec
main_shock_specs = [palm_shock, fuel_shock, coal_shock, jobloss]
panel_shock_specs = [palm_shock_panel, fuel_shock_panel, coal_shock_panel]
shock_groups = [
    "palm_farmer_hh_ifls4",
    "urban_vehicle_hh_ifls4",
    "coal_worker_hh_ifls4",
    "job_loss_1_yr",
]
shock_posts = ["ifls5", "post_subsidy", "ifls5", None]

shock_groups_panel = shock_groups[:-1]
shock_posts_panel = shock_posts[:-1]
```

# Main Effects

## Temperature Effects

```{python}
alt_temperature_specs = [
    update_formula_search_replace(temperature_spec, "tmean_c_dev", measure)
    for measure in [
        "tmean_c_dev",
        "tmean_7d_dev",
        "wetbulb_c_dev",
        "wetbulb_7d_dev",
        "hot30_7d_dev",
    ]
]

make_regression_table(
    alt_temperature_specs,
    titles=[
        "Daily Mean",
        "7-day Mean",
        "Wet-bulb Current",
        "Wet-bulb 7-day",
        "7-day Hot Days",
    ],
)
```




## Main Table

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Daily Mean

```{python}
make_shock_regression_table(
    main_shock_specs,
    group=shock_groups,
    post=shock_posts,
    temperature="tmean_c_dev",
)
```

### 7-day mean

```{python}
main_shock_7_day = [
    update_formula_search_replace(spec, "tmean_c_dev", "tmean_7d_dev")
    for spec in main_shock_specs
]
make_shock_regression_table(
    main_shock_7_day,
    group=shock_groups,
    post=shock_posts,
    temperature="tmean_7d_dev",
)
```
